tei:div.tei:p: mkhas grub rā ga a s+yas mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rmongs pa mun sel bla ma pad+ma phrin las la stsal ba bzhugs so// na mo/ dkon mchog gsum 'dus bla ma 'jam dbyangs la// dus rnams rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i don du bcom ldan 'jam dpal bsgrub// stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba dang*// seṅge sngon po'i steng du dhīḥyig las// 'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas tshur 'dus pas// rang nyid 'jam dbyangs dmar po zhal gcig pa// ral gri pusti 'dzin cing skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dmar// de steng ral gri sor bzhi sngags kyis bskor// mdun du hrīḥlas dbyangs can lha mo sngo// bzhengs stabs ral gri pusti phyag na 'dzin// gnyis ka dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan// yum gyi thugs kar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng*// ral gri hrīḥs mtshan sngags kyis bskor ba'o// rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs rang la thim// thugs las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// paṇ+ḍi ta yi shes rab thams cad dang*// nyan rang so skye'i shes rab thams cad ni// 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas spyi bor thim// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi po yi// chos rnams bsdus nas rang gi mgrin par thim// nyi zla nor bu 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud// bsdus nas rang gi snying gar thim par gyur// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me di paṃ mañdzu shrī muṃ hrīḥpradz+nya war+dha ni hrīḥdhīḥswāhā/ rang las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo ni// nam mkha' gang bar sprul te lha la mchod// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// rgyal srid bdun dag bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// ri rab gling bzhi lha mi'i longs spyod kun// blo yis blangs te 'jam dpal yab yum mchod// bdag la bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad ni// thogasamed mkhyen pa'i shes rab myur du stsol// seṅge pad+ma'i gdan steng du// rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// mdog dmar ral gri pu sti 'dzin// smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal// chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan steng du// sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// mdog sngon ral gri spu sti 'dzin// dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de yan rgyun du 'don rgyu dang*// sngags de brgya phrag re zung tsam// rgyun du thugs dam byed par gces// 'di yi phan yon rgyud gzhung las// sngags kyi phreng ba nyi shu gcig

/brgya yi mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur// stong gis sgra skad kun la mkhas// khri yis nyin re sho lo ka /lnga stong re re 'dzin par nus// yi ge thams cad thogs med shes// bka' 'grel bstan bcos rtsom par nus// mngon par shes pa 'char ba dang*// phyis nas sa yi dbang phyug 'thob// gal te las 'phro yod pas ni// nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur// 'bring gis gnyis kyi rtogs par 'gyur// nyi ma gsum gyi bsgrub pas ni// las 'phro med kyang 'grub par 'gyur// nyi zla shar dag me tog 'thu// zhing rmo snag tsha 'thung ba dang*// nyams dga' yi ge 'bri klog dang*// mtshon cha pu sti rnyed rmis na// shes rab 'phel ba the tshom med// de skad rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta// ka ma shī las gsungs pa yin// rgya gar yul gyi mi rgan ni// lo ni dgu bcu go dgu pa// yi ge yang ni mi shes pas// zhag gcig bsgrub pas 'jam dbyangs mjal// lus kyang gzhon nu lo brgyad tsam// rig pa'i gnas lnga thogs med shes// paṇ+ḍi ta ni mkhas par gyur// de la pha gcig dam pas zhus// rim gyis brgyud de karma pa// dbang phyug rdo rjes mdzad pa yi// gcig shes kun grol nang na bzhugs// 'jam dbyangs sgrub pa thams cad las// 'di las 'grub thag nye ba med// 'di yi las tshogs shes rab kyi// ril bu sngar dus bdag gis bsgrubs// sus zos phal cher mkhas par gyur// de phyir da lam snying gi bu// pad+ma phrin las thugs dam yin// sngags 'di bsnyen pa ci gsog gyis// yon tan shugs la mkhas par gyur// bstan 'dzin 'gro don nus pa yi// ge mo bla ma zhes bya ba// mkhas pa chen po 'byung bar shog// /dge 'dis tshe rabs thams cad du// mi brjed dran pa'i gzungs thob nas// 'chad rtsod brtsom la zla med pa'i// smra ba'i seng ge nyid gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ//

'jam dpal dmar po yab yum gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na mo wā gi shwa ra ye/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung gi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// pad+ma rigs kyi bdag po ste// gsung gi rdo rje zhes kyang bya// 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// de dang ngo bo dbyer med pa// sras kyi thu bo'i tshul bzung ba// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// 'jam dpal dmar po ral gri 'dzin// smra ba'i seng ger gsol ba 'debs// shes rab yum gyi tshul bzung ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung gi lha mo dbyangs can ma// gaṅgā'i lha mo zhes bya ba'i// ngag gi lha mor gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'jug dang*// mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams// mi shes mun pa rab gsal nas// shes rab rtsa kha dbye bar shog /skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// shes rab 'chal bar mi 'gyur zhing*// shes rab phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las// mi brjed gzungs kyang thob par shog /chos nyid rnam par dag pa dang*// rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang*// 'jam dpal yab yum thugs rje yis// smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni 'jam dpal dmar po'i shes rab rdzas dang ril bu 'khor lo sogs rang gis dka' tshegs chen pos sgrub grwa rnams zhag nyer gsum la thun re bur 'don bcug pas/ khor phal cher gzhung dang mthun pa'i rmi ltas legs po byung 'dug /rnam gsum 'dzoms pa'i dus chen nyin/ dngos grub len chog tshul du rā ga a s+yas gsol ba btab pa'o/ ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la// skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skyes shing*// ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// bla ma'i byin rlabs bdag la 'jug par shog /dge'o/// /
